title: Yellow Mosaic Virus on Mungbean, Soybean and Blackgram

Header: Yellow Mosaic Virus on Mungbean, Soybean and Blackgram
Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus; Vector - Whitefly ( Bemisia tabaci ) Sinhala Mun Vichithra Virus Rogaya; Tamil - Manchal paima siththira virus noi

Prevention: Adjust planting dates to avoid peak pest population (For yala, April-May and for
Mungbean at the onset of the rains
Remove weed and alternate hosts, Hulanthala ( Ageratum conisoidez ), wild legumes ( Lathyroid spp.) etc.
Avoid establishing new crops adjacent to infected fields
Cultivate barrier crops (Maize, Sorghum) 2-3 weeks before mungbean sowing
Consider seed treatments in high risk areas
Monitoring: Regular field visits to observe diseased plants, particularly in dry season
Direct Control: Spray seedlings with neem seed water extract at the rate of 30-50g seeds/ litre during early stage of the crop (for vector control)
Restrictions: Consider the following for seed treatment:
Rate of dilution - 25g/10 li.t of water.
Rate of dilution - 3g/10 lit. of water.
Do not apply more than 2 times per season
